calculator_engine: function overlap3(f1,f2,f3){const s1=new Set(f1.split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toUpperCase()));const s2=new Set(f2.split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toUpperCase()));const s3=new Set(f3.split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toUpperCase()));function pct(a,b){const c=[...a].filter(x=>b.has(x));const u=new Set([...a,...b]);return(c.length/u.size*100).toFixed(1);}const allThree=[...s1].filter(x=>s2.has(x)&&s3.has(x));return{p12:pct(s1,s2),p13:pct(s1,s3),p23:pct(s2,s3),all3:allThree.length};}
